sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Import is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I came across some interesting devices recently. The first one is clearly a storage unit, and the second appears to be an RFID reader. Nothing like this has ever been seen in Tarkov before. Most likely, they're either from new shipments that bypassed the usual channels, or they were recovered from a sealed storage facility. Either way, both options won't stay available for long, so deliver one of each device to my people. Don't bring them directly to me - it's too risky while we don't know where these devices came from."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find the item in raid: 1 UHF RFID Reader
- Find the item in raid: 1 VPX Flash Storage Module
- Hand over the item
- Hand over the item

sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles

  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Tech manual
- Unlocks purchase of Magazine case at Mechanic LL3
"My people confirmed they received the devices. Thank you!"
